eva: FYI seeing 401s on staging after the scheduled API key rotate at 02:15. Affected: staging-ingress -> internal-api. Error: "invalid_api_key" from auth service. Repro: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" https://staging.internal/api/v1/predict` :thinking:
leo: On it. Which rotation pipeline ran? vault or manual? :eyes:
eva: rotation job `infra/rotations/staging-apikey` via cron, logs show success. Vault wrote new secret at `secret/data/staging/apikey`. KMS wrap ok. deploy-bot shows canary rollout succeeded.
deploy-bot: canary rollout finished (staging-ingress v2.3.5) — all pods restarted.
sara: Did the pods pick up env change? We saw sidecar-env not hot-reload. Check `kubectl exec staging-ingress-xxx -- printenv | grep REDWOOD_API_KEY`
jordan: Also check vault-agent lease: `kubectl logs vault-agent -c vault-agent` might show lease renewals. If agent didn't reload, pods will keep old key until restart + HUP.
eva: ran `kubectl exec` — pod still has old key. `vault kv get secret/staging/apikey` returns new value. So vault updated but pod env didn't.
leo: That suggests env-sidecar doesn't watch kv2 paths. Any errors in sidecar logs? Try `kubectl logs <pod> -c env-sidecar`
sara: sidecar logs show `watcher: path secret/data/staging/apikey not found` then later `watcher: TTL exceeded, not renewing lease` — hmm looks like TTL set to 0 in secret metadata? :confused:
jordan: There's a weird TTL/lease bug in Vault when using static tokens; our rotate job might've written secret with `ttl: 0` which prevents lease creation. If no lease, agent won't auto-renew and sidecar may treat secret as static so no env refresh. Repro steps we used: rotate via the job container with `vault write secret/data/staging/apikey data.value=...` vs. the agent-friendly flow that creates a lease.
eva: Workaround is to restart the deployment to pick new env. Doing `kubectl rollout restart deployment/staging-ingress` now.
leo: Also file a fix for the rotate job to ensure lease-friendly write. Add a post-write hook: curl to sidecar refresh endpoint or emit a Kubernetes annotation that triggers rolling update. I'll open PR.
sara: For the support ticket: tell the customer we identified rotation wrote secret without lease metadata, pods didn't refresh env until restart. Offer immediate restart or patch timeline.
eva: Customer asked to avoid restarts during business hours. We proposed a 10 minute maintenance window and they accepted. :thumbsup:
support-bot: Escalation updated: status -> investigating, ticket #12345, severity P2. Assigned: eng-infra.
leo: I'll push PR and patch rotation job. Note to reviewers: check metadata block and `lease_ttl` default. Also add unit/integration test against `vault-agent` behavior. :rocket:
